description: Continue from the condition-A candidate on verified observation-action repair demonstrations (sandbox-replayed SWE-smith traces), mixed with a controlled fraction of general data to probe catastrophic forgetting.

data.contract: messages chat rows; repair rows are observation-history -> action with individually verified_good targets only

training.forgetting_probe: evaluate general-capability dev set before and after this stage

verification_gate: every repair row must carry verification.method == sandbox_replay with matching trace_sha256 and an observed green test event (prepare.py repair path rejects the rest)

authorization.device_exclusivity_required: no other Chowder campaign may hold the target device

promotion_rule: never auto-promoted; repair behavior metrics plus general-capability regression check against the condition-A student
